title: Model Comparison & Testing Utilities
summary: This module offers a `ModelLaboratory` for comparing language model chains and LLMs, complemented by utilities for object serialization, dynamic module imports, and base classes for comprehensive chat model and vector store testing.

nodes.label: Compare Model Outputs
nodes.title: ModelLaboratory
nodes.description: Initializes with multiple language model chains and compares their responses to a given input text, printing results for analysis.

nodes.label: Language Model Interface
nodes.title: BaseLLM
nodes.description: Provides a standardized interface for interacting with various Large Language Models (LLMs).

nodes.label: Chain Execution Logic
nodes.title: Chain
nodes.description: Represents a sequence of operations or components that process input and produce output, often involving LLMs and prompts.

nodes.label: Prompt Template Management
nodes.title: PromptTemplate
nodes.description: Manages and formats prompts for language models, allowing for dynamic input insertion.

nodes.label: Object Serialization
nodes.title: Serialization Utilities
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of Python objects (like Serializable and Document) to and from byte representations for storage or transmission.

nodes.label: Dynamic Module Import
nodes.title: import_by_name
nodes.description: Dynamically imports modules and their attributes by name, handling deprecation warnings and module not found errors.

nodes.label: Model Profile CLI Tool
nodes.title: langchain_model_profiles.cli.main
nodes.description: Command-line interface for refreshing and managing model profile data from external sources like models.dev.

nodes.label: Chat Model Integration Test Base
nodes.title: ChatModelIntegrationTests
nodes.description: Provides a base class for comprehensive integration tests of chat models, covering invocation, streaming, tool calling, structured output, and multimodal inputs.

nodes.label: Vector Store Integration Test Base
nodes.title: VectorStoreIntegrationTests
nodes.description: Provides a base class for integration tests of vector store implementations, verifying document addition, deletion, and retrieval.

nodes.label: Chat Model Unit Test Base
nodes.title: ChatModelUnitTests
nodes.description: Provides a base class for unit tests of chat models, focusing on initialization, serialization, and structured output configuration.

groups.label: Model Experimentation
groups.title: Model Experimentation
groups.description: Components dedicated to experimenting with and comparing the performance of different language models and chains.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utilities
groups.description: General-purpose utility functions for object serialization and dynamic module loading.

groups.label: Testing Frameworks
groups.title: Testing Frameworks
groups.description: Base classes and tools for unit and integration testing of chat models and vector stores, including CLI for model profile management.
